english.title: Attempt to possess a controlled drug of Class B - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to have in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY THE CLASS B DRUG NOT SPECIFICALLY CATERED FOR..), a controlled drug of class B, in contravention of section 5(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempt to possess a controlled drug of class B

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Dihydrocodeine is a class A drug when in injection form - i.e.(liquid). When in tablet form it is a prescription controlled drug under the Medicines Act and not deemed a classified drug for the purposes of the Misuse of Drugs Act. However when in tablet form and supplied it is a Class B drug.
(ii) This offence wording should only be used for class B drugs NOT catered for by way of a specific Standard Offence Wordings.

SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding two thousand five hundred pounds.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.
